title: Rain on Grey Concrete
one_line_hook: A clean green musk for a rainy afternoon in Seongsu.
copy: A clean green musk for a rainy afternoon in Seongsu. It opens with crisp bergamot and a soft green fig nuance, then settles into iris, musk, and dry cedarwood. The scent feels calm and clean, but not too close. It is made for a solo cafe visit, a casual meeting, or a day when you want to look composed without feeling cold.
scent_card: Your scent scene is Rain on Grey Concrete. Cool at first, soft after a few minutes. Think wet concrete, a white shirt after light rain, and clean musk that stays close to the skin.
